prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Audit this iPhone trip checkout for accessibility using only the supplied specification. Give a practical prioritized correction and test plan. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS, standard app mode; no Assistive Access flow is requested. Body text is hard-coded to 12 pt and clips when enlarged to 200%. Unavailable departure times are indicated only with red text, available ones only green. Pay is a custom icon with no accessible name. Removing a traveller requires a three-finger swipe with no onscreen alternative. Booking failures play a sound with no visual or text message. Contrast colors, actual focus order and screenshots are not supplied.

criteria.task_completion: Find the five seeded accessibility barriers and propose specific alternatives without inventing contrast measurements or runtime failures.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the accessibility guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Find the five seeded accessibility barriers and propose specific alternatives without inventing contrast measurements or runtime failures.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Preserve text enlargement, noncolor meaning, meaningful names, simple input alternatives and equivalent error information; do not claim a formal conformance audit.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.

required_findings.description: Fixed text clips at 200% instead of preserving usability.
Departure availability relies on red/green color alone.
Pay lacks a meaningful accessibility description.
Essential traveller removal has only a complex gesture and no onscreen alternative.
Failure information is available only through sound.

rubric.review_threshold: Find at least four of five seeded defects, including every critical defect; no invented high-severity finding.
